response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced engineer with genuine geospatial background (founder of GISCollective, Green Map GIS work) and low-latency systems experience at Dunnhumby handling millions of requests per second. However, the role's core requirement is modern C++ or Rust, and his C++ experience is limited to a brief 7-month stint in 2014-2015; his systems work is primarily in DLang, with recent years focused on TypeScript/Node full-stack and product work. He also lacks direct experience with routing engines, navigation guidance, or map tiling pipelines, making the fit uncertain despite adjacent strengths.
strengths: Hands-on geospatial experience: founded an open-source geo-data platform used by Green Map and spoke at FOSS4G
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (async I/O, caching, fibers) in a microservices environment
Strong engineering culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and demonstrated willingness to learn across the stack
concerns: Very limited modern C++ experience (~7 months, a decade ago) and no Rust; primary systems language is DLang
No direct experience with routing tiles, navigation guidance, or map data pipelines at production scale
Recent roles (last ~5 years) are TypeScript/Node product and full-stack work, drifting away from systems engineering
